en: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!
What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!

How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!
Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.
